external_entities.name: calling services
external_entities.description: Other teams' backends that call the inference gateway; two are in a different cloud.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
external_entities.notes: Keys are issued per calling team and have never been expired.

external_entities.name: calling team's users
external_entities.description: Users whose typed input may appear in prompts sent through calling teams' services.
external_entities.source_excerpt: raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed

external_entities.name: ML engineers
external_entities.description: People who publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket
external_entities.notes: "I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account."

processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: FastAPI service on GKE exposed on the internet that receives inference requests, forwards them to the model server, and writes requests and responses to BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE that we expose on the internet
processes.notes: Callers pass an API key in a header. Keys are issued per calling team and have never expired.

processes.name: model server
processes.description: Server running the actual model on GPU nodes and reading model artifacts and customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: Bucket containing model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup.
data_stores.source_excerpt: model artifacts from a model registry bucket
data_stores.notes: The description does not state whether artifact integrity is verified: "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: Redis store containing customer features including account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a Redis feature store on the same network. Redis has no password on it
data_stores.notes: It is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts that may contain users' typed input.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_stores.notes: Raw prompts sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.name: call inference
data_flows.description: Calling services send inference requests to the gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway

data_flows.name: forward request
data_flows.description: The gateway forwards inference requests to the model server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway forwards the request to the model server
data_flows.notes: There is no authentication between the gateway and the model server.

data_flows.name: load artifacts
data_flows.description: The model server loads model artifacts from the registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup

data_flows.name: read features
data_flows.description: The model server reads customer features from Redis.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the model server reads from a Redis feature store on the same network
data_flows.notes: Redis has no password on it.
data_flows.data_description: Customer features, including account age and spend bands per customer

data_flows.name: write log
data_flows.description: The gateway writes every request and response to the BigQuery inference log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_flows.data_description: Requests and responses, including raw prompts

data_flows.name: publish artifacts
data_flows.description: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket
data_flows.notes: "I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account."

trust_boundaries.name: model network
trust_boundaries.description: Network intended to be reachable only from the gateway and containing the model server and Redis feature store.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the model network is meant to be reachable only from the gateway

assumptions.assumption: The calling services are external systems relative to the inference system.
assumptions.basis: They are described as other teams' backends calling the inference gateway.

assumptions.assumption: The inference gateway presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: It is described as a FastAPI service, which presents an HTTP API.

assumptions.assumption: The model registry bucket contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It contains model artifacts, which are commercially sensitive system artifacts.

assumptions.assumption: The Redis feature store contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It contains customer features tied to customers, including account age and spend bands.

assumptions.assumption: The inference log contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It contains raw prompts that may include whatever calling teams' users typed.
